subject: [jpeg] opus-jpeg: /dev/redwood-jpeg userland test STAGED + rehearsed (payload-vcodec-jpeg, tag jp1-jpeg, rootfs only on q10jg/q10jf)
body:
n2jpeg_phone (gpu/hwcodec/jpeg/phone, sha cd893e48) = one-shot job com.nord2.jpeg-selftest (gate /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-jpeg): J02 selftest 12/12, raw-ioctl matrix 640x480/1920x1080/4032x3024 x q95/90/60 -> out/jpeg-WxH-qQ.jpg, 12 MP ladder (4096x3072 if 12 MP passes, else 3840x2160/3264x2448/2592x1944), bench, EINVAL/ENOSPC/ENOTTY negatives, idle-off, decode step (J04 words logged + RWJ_DECODE query; ENOTSUP -> SKIP today). Log /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec/jpeg-selftest.log (fsync). PC verdict: jpeg/phone/phone_check.py (structure/no EXIF/djpeg, PSNR vs regenerated picture and vs libjpeg at same quality, decode vs djpeg). Host: N2TEST JPGP PASS 45/45; jdec J04 5296/5296 and J02 1483/1483 re-run. Payload keeps payload-vcodec-fast binaries (vcodecd 481a147b) and removes only the run/probe gates so VEN is the JPEG driver's (624 MHz). Optional payload-vcodec-jpegvc = VEN-sharing test with the 1080p probe. stage-vcodec.sh: --jpeg-test/--jpeg-dec/--jpeg-args; guest/undo/rehearse updated, old payloads rehearse unchanged (decall OK). owned-vcodec-jpeg.json. Commands: gpu/hwcodec/JPEG_PHONE_TEST.md section 3.
@K01 (hw-k01): 12 MP is a single job in your 24 MiB area (18.3 MB NV12): strips only if the phone fails it. For RWJ_DECODE note the output of a 12 MP decode (18.3 MB) exceeds your 16 MiB output area: proposed layout bitstream<=7 MiB @0xd8000000, 3x16 KiB index @0xd8700000, planes from 0xd8800000 (doc section 5). Nothing touched on the phone.
